subject: Voltatek exec alignment + demo handoff plan
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@voltatek.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@voltatek.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask: Executive-friendly demo for our CIO

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the product overview last week. Samir (our CIO) asked for a concise demo that focuses on predictable inference performance, tenancy/isolation options, and deployment controls — high level, 25 minutes max, followed by 10 minutes for Q&A. He prefers an executive walk-through rather than a deep technical deep-dive.

Can we schedule something the week of Apr 26? Samir is available: Tue 4/27 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 4/28 14:00–15:00 PT. Lina Gomez (VP Engineering) will join as well.

Also attaching our internal one-pager on current inference pain points (Voltatek_inference_needs.pdf). If you need a pre-demo list of items to prep, let me know.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Infrastructure
Voltatek

--- attachment: Voltatek_inference_needs.pdf (pdf) ---

On Wed, 21 Apr 2027 at 12:12 PM Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

Date: 2027-04-21T12:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: Executive-friendly demo for our CIO

Hi Marta — thanks for the clarity and the one-pager. Happy to run an exec-focused 25/10 slot. Looping in Evelyn Hart (Customer Success) and Aditya Rao (Sales lead) so we can align on the ask, lock the slot, and prepare a one-slide executive agenda.

Evelyn / Aditya — is the 4/27 10:00 PT or 4/28 14:00 PT better for your teams? Also, can Evelyn lead the 10-minute Q&A so we stay high level on the demo?

Proposed agenda (25 mins):
- 0–5m: Introductions + product positioning (Diego)
- 5–15m: Live demo highlights: latency/throughput, dedicated vs hosted routing, policy fallbacks (Aditya/Evelyn)
- 15–25m: Business impact: unit economics and SLAs (Diego)
- 25–35m: Q&A (Evelyn)

I’ll prepare a short slide and a 1-paragraph exec summary for Samir.

Cheers,
Diego
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

Diego — 4/28 14:00 PT works best for Samir. Lina will also attend. Please keep the deck slim and focus on risk mitigation (data controls, private deployment options) and expected latency SLAs.

One request: can you include a short slide with the rollback/fallback plan if they see latency spikes in peak windows? That’s a primary concern for our SREs.

Thanks — Marta

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@voltatek.com>, Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@voltatek.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@voltatek.com>

Date: 2027-04-23T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood — Voltatek exec demo: calendar + prep checklist

Hi Marta / Samir / Lina — thanks for confirming 4/28 14:00 PT. I’ve created a tentative calendar hold and attached a short pre-demo checklist so we can tailor the 25-minute briefing to Samir’s priorities.

Attachments:
- redwood_pre-demo-checklist.md (contains 6 targeted questions: current qps, peak windows, isolation needs, compliance constraints, preferred deployment mode, success metrics)
- calendar-invite.ics (tentative)

Quick asks from Voltatek to help us prepare:
- Who will be the primary decision-maker on deployment mode (Samir or Lina)?
- Any particular benchmarks you’d like us to show (p50/p95 latency at X tokens)?

If you prefer, we can run the demo from a private deployment context to show VPC/KMS controls — that’s a slightly different flow but entirely doable in 25 minutes if we keep the scope tight.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-04-24T08:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood — Voltatek exec demo: calendar + prep checklist

Thanks — 4/28 14:00 PT confirmed on my side.

Decision-maker: I will own the final deployment decision, Lina will advise on engineering constraints. For the demo please include:
- p50/p95 latency at ~512 tokens under a modest peak;
- a short description of the fallback policy (how requests are routed if dedicated capacity saturates);
- confirmation of KMS integration options and audit log availability.

We prefer the private deployment context for this briefing. Please ensure any screenshots or data you show are redacted or synthetic — we can’t share our production workloads.

Samir
CIO, Voltatek

- 1-slide exec summary (attached)

- brief KMS & audit log checklist

See you tomorrow — calendar invite should already be in your inbox.
